depiction.primary_object: round analog clock face with two hands
modifiers: solid dot in bottom-right gap of the outer ring
depiction.composition: single circular icon, front view, with a cutout and dot on the lower-right rim

readings.meaning: clock, time, or specific scheduled time
time-based reminder, alert, or overdue deadline

ambiguity: At small sizes the dot in the lower-right rim blends into the circle, making it look like a plain clock icon, or the angled hand plus dot can read as a bent exclamation mark for an overdue alert.

modifier_semantics.modifier: solid dot on the lower-right rim
modifier_semantics.meaning: notification, active reminder, or specific point in time

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a clock face with a small notification dot integrated into the lower-right rim, making it fit tasks about physical clocks, opening hours, time tracking/timesheets, and timed reminders. It is slightly less distinctive than a standard clock because at small sizes the rim dot merges with the circle, and it shouldn't be overused for tasks that merely have a deadline or duration.
